description:
Track Calories and workouts inside chatgpt

Nexus gives ChatGPT a persistent record for your workouts, meals, calories, macros, body weight, nutrition goals, and progress. 

You can also Plan your workouts and body transformation goals through this record with chatgpt.

ChatGPT uses the history to make recommendations and answer questions grounded in your data.

defaultPrompt: I ate 3 boiled eggs for dinner. Estimate the macros and log it in Nexus.
I just finished bench press: 3 sets at 60 kg for 8 reps. Log this workout and show it in Nexus.
I wanna do back and biceps today, make me a workout looking at my workout history
